question: Why must the teaching be withheld from those who revile Shiva and Kula Bhairava?
premises: The teaching must not be given to a reviler of Shiva
It must not be given to a slanderer
inference: Those who revile Shiva or slander Kula Bhairava are strictly excluded from receiving the teaching.
uncertainties: kulabhairave may qualify nindake or stand as a separate referent
plain_english: O goddess, not to one who reviles Shiva, nor to a slanderer of Kula Bhairava.
